messages:
jamie: Hey folks — just joined and I can sign into my Google account but Slack says I need SSO and Okta asks for device enrollment. Also no 1Password invite showed up. Anyone able to unblock?

tess (People Ops): Welcome @jamie! We sent invites earlier today. I’ll ping IT — can you confirm the exact email address you used?

jamie: jamie@redwood.ai — double-checked spam too. Okta flow errors with 'Endpoint security required'.

devon (IT Support): @jamie I see the user record. 1Password invite was sent and bounced earlier (mailbox rules?). Can you try a different browser or incognito and check again? What OS/device are you on?

jamie: MacBook Pro M1, macOS 13.5 (personal device). Tried Chrome and Safari. No invite in inbox or spam.

lina (DevEx): FYI there was a new conditional-access rule rolled yesterday around device attestation for macOS. That could block SSO unless the device is enrolled with our MDM.

devon (IT Support): Yep — that policy is enforcing device compliance. If you can enroll the device into Jamf you should get the attestation prompt. If not, we can issue a temporary bypass. Quick check you can run on mac: `profiles status -type enrollment` — if it returns not enrolled that explains it.

jamie: I ran that and it shows not enrolled. I don’t have Jamf prompts. Is enrolling personal devices allowed?

tess (People Ops): We prefer corporate devices, but personal devices can be used with a limited exception during onboarding. @devon can you create a temporary bypass for jamie so they can finish setup?

devon (IT Support): Creating a time-limited bypass now for jamie@redwood.ai. Also re-sending the 1Password invite from admin console. Give it 5–10 minutes to propagate.

onboarding-bot: Account provisioning update — 1Password invite resent to jamie@redwood.ai. Okta bypass token created (expires in 8 hours).

jamie: Got the 1Password invite email now, thanks! Still seeing Slack SSO error when I try to sign in, though.

alex (Manager): Welcome @jamie — sorry for the friction. If you want I can jump on a quick screenshare at 2pm and help walk through it.

jamie: 2pm works for me, thanks.

devon (IT Support): Try logging out of Slack fully and signing in again now that the bypass is active. If it fails, paste the exact error or a screenshot here.

jamie: That did it, Slack login worked after a full logout/login. :raised_hands:

tess (People Ops): Thanks for the patience everyone. Note for follow-up: we’ll add a short doc on personal-device onboarding and the temporary bypass workflow. Link: https://redwood.ai/internal/onboarding/device-exceptions (internal).

jamie: All set for now. Appreciate the quick help!

onboarding-bot: Thread closed by onboarding-bot after 3h (issue resolved).
